H.title: Ancestor symlinks and resolve/open races escape the asset root
H.scenario: _measure resolves a path and checks containment, then separately opens the original pathname. O_NOFOLLOW protects only its final component. Replacing root/dir with a symlink to an outside directory after line 86 but before line 88 causes root/dir/x.txt to hash outside-root bytes. A stable in-root ancestor symlink is also followed. The service reads live project files rather than the verified private snapshots required by section 5, and master identity is checked by another later pathname resolution. Optional assets can therefore be treated as verified from an escaped source; the root boundary is already violated even when a later digest comparison fails.
H.fix: Reuse the existing verified-snapshot boundary after inspecting its actual call surface, or open from a pinned root directory descriptor and traverse every component with no-follow directory-relative opens (or an equivalent beneath/no-symlink primitive), then materialize and measure a private immutable snapshot. Bind the master object check to the opened/snapshotted object rather than another pathname lookup. Add deterministic ancestor-swap, nested-symlink and root-swap RED tests; do not rely on resolve plus final-component O_NOFOLLOW.
H.design_basis: Section 5 verified private snapshots; asset.integrity and master-object binding are non-waivable safety checks.

M.title: Tag and chapter alternatives bypass primary-value lint and shape validation
M.scenario: _tag_sets and _chapter_sets enumerate only primary/localized metadata. _variants checks counts, duplicate ids and asset presence, but never parses or checks inline tags/chapters. Under all rules, a tags alternative with 30 duplicate bad! entries and a chapter alternative starting beyond the master with an empty title both PASS without findings. Even a tags value containing only an unexpected key passes. Section 3.3 permits these alternatives to be selected and requires every alternative to be checked like the primary value.
M.fix: Define/validate a canonical value shape for every variant field, enumerate validated tag/chapter alternatives through the same bound/charset/duplicate/banned-phrase/chapter functions, and refuse malformed values. Add RED cases for malformed alternatives, count/length/charset/duplicates and chapter ordering/first-zero/end bounds, plus clean alternatives.
M.design_basis: Section 3.3 every variant is checked like the primary value; section 5 metadata/chapter/variant rules; section 8 seeded defects.

M.title: Nonregular assets can block before the regular-file guard
M.status: CONFIRMED with a temporary FIFO and killed subprocess
M.scenario: A candidate source_ref naming an existing FIFO reaches blocking os.open(O_RDONLY) before fstat can reject it. With no writer, a packaging check never completes; asyncio.to_thread has no timeout or cancellable worker boundary. Multiple commands can occupy executor threads. Regular-file reads also have no measured-size/deadline bound before fully hashing, so an undersized declaration does not cap the work.
M.fix: Use the verified snapshot reader with bounded work, reject nonregular descriptors without a blocking open (for example no-follow O_NONBLOCK then fstat), enforce measured size limits while copying/hashing and provide a bounded worker/deadline. Add FIFO/nonregular, oversized actual file and cancellation RED cases without hanging the test process.
M.design_basis: Section 5 verified private asset snapshots and byte ceilings; cheap deterministic local check.

M.title: UTF-8 media verification examines only a potentially split 64-byte prefix
M.status: CONFIRMED for both false acceptance and false rejection
M.scenario: Only the first 64 bytes reach _sniff. A text asset with 64 ASCII bytes followed by invalid UTF-8 is labeled text/plain and can satisfy integrity when the candidate declares the matching bytes. Conversely, a valid UTF-8 SRT with 63 ASCII bytes followed by a three-byte Han character is labeled application/octet-stream because the prefix cuts the character. Thus declared text media type is not established by the full bytes, and valid localized captions can fail packaging.
M.fix: Validate UTF-8 incrementally across every measured chunk and flush the decoder at EOF; keep magic-byte sniffing separate from full text validation. Add boundary-split Unicode and invalid-tail RED cases for every supported text type. Use a reused parser if semantic JSON/SRT validity is part of the promised type evidence.
M.design_basis: Section 5 verified media types and asset integrity; source _sniff explicitly promises valid UTF-8.

M.title: M8 lineage is hashed but never bound to the run/master/profile it claims
M.status: CONFIRMED by source inspection; live database scenario not executed
M.scenario: An intact PACKAGING revision can have payload fields correctly naming master A/profile A while its LineageBinding names master B, another content basis or another creative profile/policy. Recomputing digest_payload(payload, lineage) only proves the two bodies were hashed together. _inputs never compares revision.lineage to the verified run/profile; the pure check receives only revision.payload, so its mandatory master/profile checks also cannot see this mismatch. Such a revision can produce PASS despite violating the explicit PACKAGING lineage definition. This is a semantic binding defect, not a claim that an unmodified digest can be forged.
M.fix: Before measuring assets, compare every specified PACKAGING lineage field to the verified run subject and profile: content_basis_digest, approved_master_id/digest, creative_profile_id/version and policy_digest. Refuse mismatches with a typed stale/evidence error; enforce the same binding on append and load. Add one-field-at-a-time RED cases with freshly recomputed legitimate M8 payload digests.
M.design_basis: Section 3.1 explicitly defines M8 LineageBinding for PACKAGING; D3 exact candidate/base-subject evidence; mandatory master/profile binding.
